owner_decisions_encoded.note_untrained_controllers: MPPI and the classical controllers have no training seeds. MPPI's sampling seed is a fixed controller parameter (controller_seeds.mppi), never chosen by performance.
owner_decisions_encoded.ppo_seed_rule: candidates are trained in the declared candidate_order; the declared competence gate is evaluated on the selection namespace; the first 3 candidates that pass are used; failed (dead) candidates are recorded in the gate ledger and reported, never silently dropped
owner_decisions_encoded.seed_42: 42 stays a candidate (first in the proposed order) but must be retrained on the new physics; no checkpoint produced before the freeze is admissible
owner_decisions_encoded.test_seed_rule: evaluation (test) seed blocks are never chosen by performance; only validity checks apply: scenarios generate, and no integer overlap with training, selection, pilot or calibration namespaces
owner_decisions_encoded.crossmachine_rule: cross-machine calibration uses a stratified sample, not the full table

ppo_training.selection_mode_status: owner confirmed 2026-10-03 17:0x (decision record 09, decision pack 02 item 6)

selection_mode_confirmation.rule: train 3, deliver 3, no picking: the first admit_first_passing (3) candidates of candidate_order are trained and all of them are delivered; the competence gate only flags each one (pass / below_gate / diverged); no candidate is replaced, skipped or chosen by performance
selection_mode_confirmation.source: NC 09 decision record, entry '2026-10-03 17:0x (owner, reply to decision pack 02)', item 6 (first stated 2026-10-01 10:1x, decision record line 40); restated in CONTEXT_R6 section 3 (PPO)
selection_mode_confirmation.freeze_note: the confirmation fixes the selection rule only: status stays 'proposal' and competence_gate.status stays 'OWNER_DECISION_PENDING' until the owner freezes both; campaign ('training') seeds stay refused until then (resolve_training_block); training-smoke seeds stay usable

selection_modes.first_passing: Mode A: candidates are trained in candidate_order; the first admit_first_passing candidates whose final checkpoint passes the competence gate are delivered (flag 'pass'); if the declared candidates are exhausted with fewer passes, fallback_rule applies
selection_modes.fixed_first_n: Mode B: the first admit_first_passing candidates of candidate_order are trained and delivered; the competence gate is still run on each and only flags it 'pass' or 'below_gate' ('diverged' when training diverged); no candidate is replaced

ppo_training.fallback_rule_text: Mode A only (owner B9, 2026-10-01 00:0x): if fewer than admit_first_passing of the declared candidates pass, the first admit_first_passing candidates in declared order whose training completed are delivered, each flagged 'pass' or 'below_gate' by its own gate verdict; the gate is never relaxed after outcomes are seen
ppo_training.failed_seed_policy: a candidate whose training diverged or whose final checkpoint fails the gate is DEAD: it keeps its ledger record, is reported in the coverage table, and is never retried or replaced out of order
ppo_training.infrastructure_failure_policy: a run interrupted by host/driver/queue failure is not a learning outcome: it is rerun with the SAME seed and later candidates are not considered until it is resolved

competence_gate.checkpoint_rule: owner 2026-10-14: the gate is evaluated on the DELIVERED checkpoint of the fixed, predeclared training budget, which is the checkpoint best on the validation block selection-02 (seed 11002, calm, 64 x 1): checkpoints every 2 % of the budget plus the untrained network, ties -> the later checkpoint (ppo_checkpoint_eval.py select); the last checkpoint is also evaluated and reported. Test seeds never take part in the choice. The field 'checkpoint' keeps the value 'final' only because the gate code implements one mode (validate_gate_definition); it means the delivered checkpoint of the run, chosen by this rule
competence_gate.condition: nominal task condition (no dose preset, no --set) at the task's frozen main-table geometry level
competence_gate.statistic: successes on the complete 64 x 2 grid
competence_gate.rationale: FROZEN by the owner 2026-10-14 (threshold 0.2 kept). A low absolute bar detects collapsed (dead) training runs without ranking healthy seeds by performance; it is the same for every task and vessel and is declared before any campaign training run.

training_smoke.rule: diagnostic training-smoke runs only (TRAINING_DESIGN section 7); never a campaign candidate, never an evaluation seed; allowed while the registry is a proposal

final_test.replacement_rule: a block that fails a validity check for a task is replaced, for that task only, by the first unused 'reserve' block in declared order; outcomes are never inspected
final_test.main_set_rule: owner 2026-10-14: the main test set is the single block final-01 (seed 41041); final-02, final-03 and final-04 are unused reserves (cohort 'reserve'; with the replacement_rule they are the first reserves in declared order). Seeds and block ids are unchanged.
